reading.supported: A real, egalitarian favour economy operates with almost no free-riding (201 givers vs 2 takers; Gini 0.099) and a largely consistent double-entry ledger (89%).
reading.not_supported: The flagship 'emergent multi-agent supply chain to build the ark' is not demonstrated: only 1 ark exists (single-contributor), and 95% of constructions are solo builds. The flood is not yet forcing coalitions at this scale.
reading.caveat: Observational (live snapshot), not a controlled ablation. Reciprocity is low (10%) — cooperation is one-directional generosity, not tit-for-tat. Some arks/constructions were operator- or demo-seeded.
